sentences.en: Algeria should commit itself to reducing its greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚应该致力于减少其温室气体排放。

sentences.en: Carbon emissions trading has yet to take off in earnest.
sentences.zh: 碳排放交易尚未真正启动。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to make significant decreases of carbon dioxide emission.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要大幅减少二氧化碳排放量。

senses.zh: 排放物，散发物；（尤指光、热、气等的）散发，排放；射精，遗精；<古>发行

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+miss（放出）+ion →放出→（光、热等）的散发
